governing_summaries_from_existing_author.governing_conditions_defaults_types_unit: Intra-work relation names include isPreprintOf/hasPreprint, isVersionOf/hasVersion, variant and manifestation. A typed relation can target another agency's DOI or non-DOI identifier. Missing DOI causes deposit failure; non-DOI identifiers are unverified. DOI deposits create reciprocal relations; the second item's own metadata need not assert it.
governing_summaries_from_existing_author.applicability_judgment: Final uses an analogy and source-conditioned asserted links, not universal deduplication or consumer truth. Related manifestations remain separate.
